rationale: C16 is a strong plausible template: both are extremely brief telegraphic personal tributes consisting of an addressee, a one-sentence expression of greetings, a concise statement praising the honoree's exemplary character or work, and the President's signature. The child adapts C16's birthday cable format to greetings relayed through Senator Thurmond for a dinner honoring James F. Byrnes. C11 and C23 share greeting or commendatory language but are structurally less similar and substantially longer or differently purposed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Please give my warm greetings to your guest of honor, Jimmy Byrnes.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: My cordial greetings and best wishes on your eightieth birthday.
shared_material.explanation: Both use a compact personal-message formula conveying warm or cordial greetings for an occasion honoring a named individual.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am fortunate to count him my good friend and with countless others salute him as a great American.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your spirit and work have been an example and inspiration to all of us.
shared_material.explanation: Each follows the greeting with a single concise sentence presenting the honoree as an exemplary figure admired beyond the President personally.
